subject.title: Agent tool call infinite loop + model.completed usage always 0

question: Should rolling no-progress tool-loop detection become a default-on safety boundary, or should OpenClaw retain the current opt-in default and handle this report only as a provider usage bug?
rationale: Changing the existing default affects legitimate repeated workflows and all providers, while the usage symptom can be repaired independently after its provider contract is established.

options.title: Split and evaluate defaults
options.body: Keep the usage regression actionable here and route default-on loop policy to the existing canonical circuit-breaker discussion before changing global behavior.

options.title: Enable conservative default guard
options.body: Make generic identical-call/outcome blocking default-on with conservative thresholds and explicit fresh-install and upgrade proof.

options.title: Retain opt-in behavior
options.body: Keep rolling detection disabled by default, improve setup and diagnostics guidance, and limit code work to usage propagation.

recommendation.title: Split and evaluate defaults
recommendation.body: Keep the usage regression actionable here and route default-on loop policy to the existing canonical circuit-breaker discussion before changing global behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent work on bounding long-running agent tool loops is the closest available history signal for the default-policy decision.
